svg.aria-label: PR Board in a browser, light theme, on the fictional demo organization: the header counts 12 ready to merge, 16 something missing, 15 ready to approve and 3 drafts, above the filter bar; a To review band lists 4 teammates' PRs that ask for your review; then one band per category, one row per PR with a coloured left bar, the number, repository and branch, title, signal chips and the next step, and a PR that waits on another sitting under it.
